entries.label: Public 0.689 recipe copy
entries.what: Unchanged public recipe, mount paths repaired after failed first preview. Submitted; saved status pending, no score receipt.

entries.label: Full-pool Qwen added to the 0.683 recipe
entries.what: The public 0.683 recipe with our new full-pool Qwen model mixed in at ten percent. It lost to the same recipe without it.

entries.label: Public 0.683 recipe, control
entries.what: The public 0.683 recipe run unchanged on our account. The author reported 0.683 and we got 0.679, 0.003 under our best.

entries.label: Tokenizer and byte models on the 0.682 recipe
entries.what: The public 0.682 recipe with ten percent tokenizer models and twenty percent raw-byte models mixed in. It lost.

entries.label: Public 0.682 recipe, control (our best)
entries.what: The public 0.682 recipe run unchanged on our account. It matched the author's score and is our best entry.

entries.label: Earlier Qwen added to the 0.682 recipe
entries.what: The public 0.682 recipe with ten percent of our earlier Qwen3-8B model mixed in. It lost.

entries.label: Tokenizer model added to the 0.682 recipe
entries.what: The public 0.682 recipe with ten percent of our tokenizer model mixed in. It lost.

entries.label: Public 0.681 ensemble run
entries.what: A full run of the public 0.681 ensemble on our account. It beat our old best of 0.651 by 0.030.

entries.label: Our own Qwen model alone
entries.what: Our own trained Qwen3-8B model submitted by itself to test the pipeline end to end. It scored 0.585, close to its 0.588 local score and well below the public ensemble.

entries.label: First public neural ensemble
entries.what: The public neural ensemble, the 0.651 recipe, run in full on our account. Our first strong board score.

entries.label: Our own CPU classifier
entries.what: Our own character, word and style classifier, trained on the official labels, to prove an entry of ours runs on the hidden test.

entries.label: Public baseline, second try
entries.what: A second try at the public 0.651 notebook, still with our extra wrapper code. It crashed on the hidden test and earned no score.

entries.label: Public baseline, first try
entries.what: The first try at the public 0.651 notebook, with our extra wrapper code. It crashed on the hidden test and earned no score.
